# BGO Shine Hub

> Professional car wash and vehicle care business in Nairobi, Kenya, open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Offers exterior washing, interior cleaning/detailing, engine greasing, and air freshening for saloons, SUVs, vans, and commercial vehicles, across three Nairobi locations.

BGO Shine Hub washes and details vehicles - from a quick exterior rinse to full interior detailing and paint protection - and also serves commercial/fleet vehicles (matatus, buses, lorries, canters). Pricing ranges roughly KES 200-5,000 depending on service and vehicle size.

## Locations

- [Njiru](https://bgoshinehub.co.ke/njiru): Njiru, Nairobi. Open 24 hours, 7 days a week.
- [Kayole](https://bgoshinehub.co.ke/kayole): Kayole, Nairobi. Open 24 hours, 7 days a week.
- [Utawala](https://bgoshinehub.co.ke/utawala): Utawala, Nairobi. Open 24 hours, 7 days a week.

## Services

- Basic Wash - full-body exterior wash for saloons, SUVs, vans, and more.
- Flash Wash - fast exterior-only rinse and wipe-down.
- Interior Vacuuming - quick vacuum of seats, mats, and boot space.
- Full Interior Detailing - complete deep clean of every interior surface.
- Premium Wax & Polish - protective waxing and buffing.
- Leather Care & Conditioning - deep cleaning and conditioning for leather seats.
- Dashboard Care & UV Protection - polish and UV-protectant treatment.
- Car Air Fresheners - a range of scents.
- Commercial & Fleet Washing - matatus, buses, lorries, and canters.
